say: Excuse me, how do I get to the station? — Go straight on and take the second street on the left.
q: How do you get to the station?
explain: 'Take the second street on the left.'

say: The museum opens at nine thirty, but the café doesn't open until eleven.
explain: The café opens at eleven; the museum at 9:30.

say: I usually walk to school, but today I'm going by bike because I'm late.
q: How is the speaker going to school today?
explain: Usually walks, but TODAY by bike.

say: These shoes were forty pounds, but in the sale they're only twenty-five.
q: How much are the shoes now?

say: Let's meet outside the cinema at quarter to seven.
I'd like a cheese sandwich and a cup of tea, but no sugar, thanks.
q: What does the speaker NOT want?

say: My sister is taller than me, but my brother is the tallest in the family.
Tomorrow will be cloudy in the morning, with sunshine in the afternoon.
q: What will the afternoon be like?

say: I've been to Paris twice, but I've never been to Rome.
q: Where has the speaker never been?

say: The train to Oxford will leave from platform four. It's running ten minutes late.
explain: 'Ten minutes late.' Platform four is a distractor.

say: Can you buy some eggs and milk on your way home? We've got enough bread.

q: Why is the pool closed on Mondays?

say: You can borrow three books for two weeks.
q: How long can you keep the books?

say: I'll have the chicken salad, please. Oh, and no onions.
The film starts at seven forty-five, so let's meet at half past seven.
My cousin lives in Manchester, but she's moving to London next month.
q: Where does the cousin live now?
explain: She lives in Manchester now; she's moving next month.

say: I'd love to come, but I've got a piano lesson on Thursday.

say: Last year I went to Spain by plane, but this year we're driving to France.
q: How will they travel this year?

q: How much is the blue jumper?

say: I've had this bike for two years. It was a birthday present from my uncle.
q: Who gave the speaker the bike?

say: Hurry up! The next bus isn't for another forty minutes.
options: The next bus is much later.
explain: If they miss this bus, they'll wait 40 minutes.

say: Sorry I'm late. There was an accident on the motorway.
explain: 'There was an accident on the motorway.'
